meta.title: Historical savings update correctly on bids when an RFQ is converted into an auction
gaps: Verify that the Historical Savings value is recalculated from the auction final price rather than the original RFQ price.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the Historical Savings value is recalculated from the auction final price rather than the original RFQ price.

steps.note: Open the prepared converted auction directly on its Overview tab.
Verify that the Historical Savings card is visible on the Overview.
Ensure the Overview renders without missing values, raw identifiers, or application errors.
